title: NACA0012 airfoil at AoA=4°, Re=1×10⁶
geometry: NACA0012 profile, chord c=1m, span=0.1m extrusion, thin-wing slice
question: Compute the lift coefficient Cl on the airfoil surface at AoA=4°. Use steady incompressible RANS (simpleFoam recommended). Report observed Cl integrated over the airfoil surface.

reference.source: Abbott & Doenhoff, Theory of Wing Sections, Dover 1959, Fig 4-5 linear region

notes: Linear-region slope ≈ 2π per radian; AoA=4° = 0.0698 rad → Cl ≈ 0.44. ±5% relative absorbs solver / mesh / turbulence-model variance. Use a C-grid topology if possible; refine near the sharp trailing edge.
